caption:
4 duas to make your own, from the Qur'an and the Sunnah.

Swipe through slowly. Yusuf asks Allah to let him die in submission and join the righteous. The believers ask to be forgiven and to die among the righteous. Another verse asks Allah not to burden us beyond what we can bear. And the Prophet ﷺ used to ask for good in this world and in the Hereafter.

Surah Yusuf 12:101
Surah Aal-i-Imraan 3:193
Surah Al-Baqara 2:286
Sahih al-Bukhari 4522 · Grade: Sahih

Which of these duas will you memorize this week?
